title: Refine reviewed gen4 envelopes: conditional kappa = 0.000723571593879006127174
body:
This adds a small conditional parameter and envelope refinement of the reviewed PR279 gen4 construction:

- Baseline: kappa = 0.000723571590007464.
- Candidate: kappa = 361785796939503063587 / 500000000000000000000000 = 0.000723571593879006127174.
- Absolute gain: 3.871542127174e-12 (approximately 0.00000053506%). This remains below stronger concurrent submissions, including PR #369, and makes no global record claim.

The proof retains the physical word, frames, banks, literal stock, prime threshold and complex supplier. It uses the unrounded full Gaussian fallback count, tighter conditioning on invertibility, and disjoint good/bad power moments. Seven fixed ordinary-leaf levels and positive rational outer parameters complete the witness. All fallback, selector and finite primitive charges remain included; the reviewed selected-result record stays unchanged.

The package contains a conditional proof argument and attribution, deterministic source-bound certificate, one-command verifier, 15 regression/contract tests and dedicated Linux CI. Eleven improvement cycles preserve all 55 trials, including the non-improving beta search and rejected parameters. Evidence Forge retains the investigation and historical failures; its independent assessments establish captured JSON facts, not a formal theorem or external test execution.

Validation:

- Both rational moment engines, next coarse/headline exclusions, 47 strict inequalities, seven margins, finite cutoff gaps and nine adverse controls pass.
- All 15 new tests pass on Windows and Ubuntu/WSL; four existing selected-result tests pass.
- All nine mandatory stages of the fresh inherited physical replay passed, followed by the refined verifier (about 603 seconds total). Exact scope and receipt hashes are recorded in `research/gen4-envelope-refinement/VALIDATION.md`.
- Canonical certificate bytes match across Windows and Linux. The initial Windows legacy-encoding replay failure is retained; the launcher now explicitly uses UTF-8.
- `make verify` could not start locally because GNU Make is unavailable. The complete affected physical pipeline runs directly in Python; the existing broad CI remains separate.

The all-size compiler, common-chart, restored-row, selector/routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex symbolic and analytic-transfer interfaces remain conditional. This is neither a full formal multiplication theorem nor a practical runtime improvement. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; predecessor credits and Apache-2.0 notices are retained.
